item.title: Pentagon says Iranian aggression remains 'below threshold' for renewed war
item.description:
The Pentagon has assessed that recent Iranian provocations, including maritime strikes and attacks on US forces, remain below the threshold for restarting major combat operations. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth stated that the April 7 ceasefire is holding, even as the US military launches "Project Freedom" to escort commercial ships through the blockaded Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Amid ceasefire: Iran strikes UAE for second straight day
item.description:
Iran launched missiles and drones at the UAE on Tuesday, prompting air defenses to activate, a day after a separate Iranian strike damaged an energy facility near Fujairah and wounded three foreign workers.

item.title: Report: Iran president calls UAE missile strike 'madness,' says he was kept in the dark
item.description:
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian erupted at Revolutionary Guards leadership over a missile and drone strike on the UAE he knew nothing about, calling it "utter madness" – as his inner circle warned Iran lacks the capacity for another full-scale war.

item.title: House Democrats demand Trump expose Israel's nuclear program
item.description:
Twenty-nine House Democrats signed a letter urging the Trump administration to formally acknowledge Israel's undeclared nuclear weapons program, calling Washington's half-century of silence indefensible as the Middle East war with Iran deepens.
